notes.title: NEW! Trial Version Update
notes.notes:
Release Notes (ver 0.5.33)

Overview
Introduced a version number for the dungeon generation logic.
Added a menu option to replay the tutorial dungeon.
Removed level-ups within dungeons.
Various bug fixes.

Details
1.
Previously, dungeons generated with different versions of the application were inaccessible.
As a result, once the application was updated, players could no longer play dungeons shown in previously published videos.
Since frequent application updates are expected in the future, we have separated the application version from the dungeon generation logic version.

2.
Until now, the tutorial could only be played once.
However, as some players may want to review the tutorial, we have added an option in the main menu that allows players to replay it.

3.
Previously, defeating enemies in dungeons granted experience points, leading to level-ups that improved basic stats.
However, leveling up within dungeons was somewhat unclear and, more importantly, could undermine the game’s core mechanic of managing items within dungeons.
To address this, we have removed level-ups within dungeons.
Instead, some stats can now be improved by using SP (Spirit Points), which are earned by completing dungeon runs, in the Status tab of the main menu.

notes.title: The demo version has been released!
notes.notes:
A demo version is now available, allowing you to experience the first two areas for free!
[code]This demo app is designed with multiplayer gameplay in mind.
When playing solo, you may encounter doors that cannot be opened,
but it is still possible to complete the game.
The full version is planned to include adjustments to
ensure it can be enjoyed in single-player mode as well.[/code]


Conquer the Fire Area and calm the Fire Spirit, Arg!

Conquer the Water Area and calm the Water Spirit, Varna!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44827071/00134ff2e9307f2aa4dafe572ab3503e035109b0.png

Share your dungeon ID with other players to get their support!
Multiplayer is available even in the demo version.
One main player can progress through the same dungeon with an unlimited number of support players.
There are no restrictions on the number of players in the demo version, so feel free to team up with as many people as you like!
